the operator and the table (smallest power of two, keys filled with Long.MIN_VALUE)
declared methods: get, hash, key, getMaxCache; nothing else reads or writes the table
rval from the mixed world seed and (x, z) alone
floorMod(rval >> 24, bound), then rval advances with the seed

weightedEntries.getRandom(context) mapped to the entry index, or the default index
